runtime_adapter: FEVER initial answer parsed with existing parser; original text and original/effective hashes retained; no gold use

statistics.bootstrap_CI: percentile, two-sided 95%; one-sided 95% lower also descriptive
statistics.NI_test: conservative exact gain/loss Clopper-Pearson bounds with union bound, inverted to p-value; lower power explicitly disclosed
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm across all four p-values; ordinary bootstrap bounds are not multiplicity-adjusted
statistics.development_results: descriptive only, not final confirmatory evidence
statistics.AC5_cost_scope: Incremental after C1 separately reported; full-pipeline AC5 not certified without common C1 costs and complete token accounting

T5_decision.loss_units: correct answers, not mixed with milliseconds or tokens
T5_decision.priority: larger of avoidable_harm and missed_repair_opportunities; ties prioritize harm
T5_decision.disable_action_candidate: Only if negative net on actual Adaptive-routed subset; global Always net negative alone is insufficient
T5_decision.routing_candidate: Only existing cached fixed-action outputs may be replayed; new Probe calls or changed module inputs require new execution
T5_decision.module_candidate: Only after observed fixed-action residual errors or harm on the relevant subset; no intrinsic-capability claim
T5_decision.selection_rule: positive paired net gain vs frozen baseline; ties keep baseline
T5_decision.unknown_semantics: NQ semantic review and unresolved bounds separate; do not promote on unconfirmed semantic claims

human_review.NQ: All distinct changed-answer pairs across main groups, de-duplicated; initial/final correctness separate
human_review.FEVER: automatic label accuracy; evidence support, ambiguity and flagged failures still reviewed
human_review.AC6: at least 50 flagged queries; observed precision >=0.90; report coverage; not yet fulfilled
human_review.trace_review: at least 50 complete traces, reviewers not developing estimator; may overlap AC6 but report both criteria separately
human_review.flags: operational warnings only; no gold or new model calls online; unflagged is unverified, never automatically success
